title: Max and Friends Treasure Adventure
moral: Friendship and teamwork make every adventure special.

scenes.summary: Max finds a mysterious map and invites his friends on an adventure.
scenes.text: Max found a crinkly old map in his backyard and showed it to his friends Charlie and Lily.
scenes.image_prompt: kids looking at old treasure map in backyard, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: They follow the map and discover a hidden path behind a fence.
scenes.text: They followed the map through the neighborhood and found a tiny hidden door in a wooden fence.
scenes.image_prompt: kids crawling through small door in fence into secret path, bright cartoon

scenes.summary: They travel along a magical path and cross a pond.
scenes.text: They walked along a flower-lined path and used a rowboat to reach a small island.
scenes.image_prompt: kids rowing small boat across pond to island, cheerful cartoon

scenes.summary: They find and open a treasure box under a tree.
scenes.text: They dug near a big tree and found a wooden treasure box filled with marbles and shells.
scenes.image_prompt: kids opening treasure chest under tree with colorful marbles, cartoon

scenes.summary: They return home happy and value their friendship.
scenes.text: They returned home smiling, knowing their friendship was the best treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: kids walking home together smiling at sunset, warm cartoon

story: Max found a mysterious map in his backyard and showed it to his friends Charlie and Lily. Together, they followed the map through their neighborhood and found a hidden door in a fence. On the other side, they discovered a secret path and used a small boat to reach an island. There, they dug near a big tree and found a treasure box filled with marbles, shells, and a book. After their adventure, they returned home happy, realizing that their friendship was the greatest treasure.
